data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'idem' meaning 'same' or 'equal', Idette derives from the term 'idolum' or 'idol'. This name was used for a little one who was considered a divine image, reflecting the belief that every child is a unique manifestation of God's love. The name Idette carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Idette usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
